title: Théorie arithmétique. Théorie de Galois des motifs (1965) : notes manuscites (s.d.), tapuscrit (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
This typed page ("- 24 -") is unrelated to the handwritten notes on either side of it, which concern Deuring/Demazure categories and torsors under H^1(A, μ_2). It is a page from a typescript on analytic functions over a complete valued field K of characteristic 0. It proves the existence and uniqueness theorem for analytic ODEs with parameters by the Cauchy method of majorants. The language ("séries sommables", "substituables", "§1, th. 2") resembles Bourbaki-style drafts on analytic varieties (Variétés différentielles et analytiques), so it is plausibly a reused sheet of scrap paper.

Setting, reconstructed:
- System (12): du_i/dx = f_i(x; u_1,…,u_p; z_1,…,z_q).
- Each f_i is a convergent power series (14) with coefficients g_i(n; r_1,…,r_p; λ_1,…,λ_q), defined on a neighbourhood P.
- One seeks power series u_i(x; z) = Σ h_i(m; μ_1,…,μ_q) x^m z^μ vanishing at x = 0.

Equating coefficients gives (15): m·h_i(m; μ) = Σ g_i(n; r; λ) · ∏_j ∏_{k=1}^{r_j} h_j(s_kj; ν_kj1,…,ν_kjq). The sum runs over index systems satisfying (16):
- m − 1 = n + Σ_j Σ_k s_kj,
- μ_ℓ = λ_ℓ + Σ_j Σ_k ν_kjℓ.

The degree argument:
- Adding the relations (16) gives m + Σμ_ℓ = 1 + n + Σλ_ℓ + Σ_j Σ_k (s_kj + Σ_ℓ ν_kjℓ).
- All indices are nonnegative, so every factor satisfies s_kj + Σ_ℓ ν_kjℓ < m + Σμ_ℓ.
- Since char K = 0, one can divide by m. Hence the coefficients of total degree t in u_i are determined by those of total degree < t.
- Induction on t then gives uniqueness of the formal solution.

Existence: if the formal series converge near the origin of K^{q+1}, they are continuous there. So one can choose a neighbourhood U×W whose image lies in P and on which substitution into (14) is legitimate (§1, th. 2). Termwise differentiation together with (15) then shows the u_i solve (12) on U×W.

The page ends by starting the majorant step: take majorant series with coefficients G_i(n; r; λ) for the f_i, and define H_i(m; μ) by the same recursion. The proof that the H_i converge continues on a page not supplied.
errors: No mathematical error. The strict inequality follows directly from the displayed identity because all indices are nonnegative.
Minor typographical slips in the typescript: 'Ufi W' for 'U×W', 'sommm bilité', 'voisina ge'.

ideas.what: Formal recursive determination and uniqueness of power-series solutions of an analytic ODE system with parameters, via a total-degree induction (characteristic 0 needed to divide by m).
ideas.modern_name: Cauchy–Kovalevskaya / analytic ODE existence and uniqueness over a complete valued field
ideas.usually_credited_to: Cauchy (majorant method); over general valued fields, standard texts such as Bourbaki, Variétés différentielles et analytiques, and Serre, Lie Algebras and Lie Groups (Part II)
ideas.where_published: Standard textbook material; this typescript is probably not by Grothendieck (likely reused scrap paper)

ideas.what: Method of majorant series (coefficients G_i, H_i) to prove convergence of the formal solution.

deep.surprise_reason: This is a page of a standard textbook-style proof (probably a Bourbaki-type typescript reused as scrap paper) of the analytic ODE existence and uniqueness theorem by majorants. It has no connection to the surrounding motivic/torsor notes and contains nothing new.
transcription_corrections: The text should read 'dans U×W' at the end of the first proof paragraph. The typescript has 'U∈W' / 'UxW', and the transcription already renders it correctly.
Upper limit of the inner sums in (16): it is r_j, as the transcription has it; the image shows faint handwritten indices.
The page is a typed sheet (with faded ink) interleaved among handwritten notes. It is likely the reverse side of reused paper rather than part of the 'Théorie de Galois des motifs' notes.
